title: Efficacy and safety of topical finasteride spray solution for male androgenetic alopecia: a phase III, randomized, controlled clinical trial
authors: B. M. Piraccini; U. Blume-Peytavi; F. Scarci; J. M. Jansat; M. Falqués; R. Otero; M. L. Tamarit; J. Galván; V. Tebbs; E. Massana; Topical Finasteride Study Group
journal: Journal of the European Academy of Dermatology and Venereology
concentration: Topical 0.25% w/w spray (2.275 mg/mL); oral 1 mg comparator
summary: The topical spray improved target-area hair count versus placebo. The paper reports >100-fold lower maximum plasma finasteride concentrations than oral therapy and serum DHT reductions of 34.5% versus 55.6%.
limitations: Published online in 2021; journal issue 2022, 36:286–294. Product-, dose- and vehicle-specific results; systemic exposure was not zero. Does not validate BioHair X 0.2% or its combination.
verification: Verified from supplied full-text PDF
